description: Level 2 for a listing of your company on level 1: action start {listing} opens the check and returns its steps. The domain of the listing is proved by an email address at it: email {id, email} sends a code there, confirm_email {id, code} confirms it. Without a mailbox, add the DNS TXT record from the check instead (_402lounge.<host>, value 402lounge-verify=<token>). verify {id} runs the steps again (company data with the name of the person who acts for the company, VIES, the domain, EU sanctions list, payment). Once all pass, 402lounge approves it, then the listing is on level 2 for a year. checkout {id} gives the Polar link for 10 € a year, included in Books. get {id}, withdraw {id}.

action.description: start, get, verify, email, confirm_email, checkout or withdraw, as the description explains

code.description: confirm_email: the six-digit code from the mail

email.description: email: an address at the domain of the listing

id.description: The check, from start. Every action but start needs it

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: seller.check
title: The company check of a listing (level 2)
